query: CREATE OR REPLACE MODEL safeher.ncrb_risk_model_v1 OPTIONS (model_type='boosted_tree_classifier', num_parallel_tree=1, max_tree_depth=4, input_label_cols=['risk_label'], data_split_method='NO_SPLIT') AS SELECT * EXCEPT (state, district, year, split, is_kerala, total_lag1) FROM safeher.ncrb_panel WHERE split='TRAIN'

SELECT district, lat AS lat_zone, lng AS lng_zone, year AS forecast_year,
               predicted_risk_label,
               ROUND((SELECT p.prob FROM UNNEST(predicted_risk_label_probs) p WHERE p.label = 'HIGH'), 3)
                 AS high_risk_probability
        FROM ML.PREDICT(MODEL `safeher-app-9251b.safeher.ncrb_risk_model_v1`, (SELECT * FROM `safeher-app-9251b.safeher.kerala_forecast`))
        ORDER BY district
